item.title: Miami University Girl Scout Day Event
item.description:
Miami University SWE (Society of Women Engineers) is hosting Girl Scout Day on April 4th, 2026 from 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM at the Miami University Engineering Buildings. The event is open to any 3rd-8th grade students and will explore various fields of engineering through activities like egg drops and paper lab tours. Lunch will be provided. Registration is available via QR code on the flyer.

item.title: April 2026 Breakfast and Lunch Menus
item.description:
Marshall Elementary's April 2026 breakfast and lunch menus are now available. Breakfast items include options like French Toast Bites (April 16), Mini Maple Pancakes (April 15), Biscuits & Sausage Gravy (April 17, 29), and various breakfast pizzas and donut holes throughout the month. Lunch offerings feature items such as Popcorn Chicken Dinner Roll (April 9, 30), BBQ Boneless Chicken Wings (April 15), Walking Taco with Doritos (April 14), and Mac & Cheese with Garlic Toast (April 23). All meals include 100% fruit juice, fresh fruit selections, and choice of milk. Note: No school on April 6.

item.description:
Right to Read Week will be celebrated March 23-27, 2026 with a pirate-themed "BOOKaneers - Finding Treasure in Books" adventure. Students can also complete "Reading Isles" activities (Mermaid Lagoon, Shipwreck Island, Plankwalk Bay, Skull Island, and Treasure Island) earning 10 doubloons each. item.title: TMS PTG Meeting and Board Introduction
item.description:
The Talawanda Middle School PTG is holding a meeting on March 23rd at 2:30 PM in the TMS Media Center to plan goals and vision for the 2026-2027 school year. The 2026-2027 PTG board includes Sarah Meaney (President), Stephene Seals-Spahn (Vice President), Jenna Fillmore (Treasurer), and an open Secretary position. Parents, students, teachers, and staff are invited to help brainstorm new ways to support students and TMS staff. Those interested in the Secretary position should email tmsptgbrave@gmail.com.

item.title: Miami University Caregiver Group for ADHD
item.description:
Miami University Psychology Clinic is offering a Caregiver Group focused on Understanding and Managing ADHD in 6-12 year olds. The group meets Wednesdays 5:30-7:00pm in-person starting in March. To participate, caregivers must: have a child aged 6-12 diagnosed with ADHD, complete a 1-hour pre-group intake session, and commit to 8 weeks of attendance. Contact: 513-529-2423 or psychologyclinic@miamioh.edu

item.description:

item.description:
Marshall Elementary is hosting a Scholastic Book Fair March 9th-12th. Volunteers must have a completed volunteer application on file before helping. item.title: Spring Break Reading Activities for Families
item.description:
Reading activities during Spring Break help maintain student literacy skills while making reading feel like play, not schoolwork. Suggested activities include: reading a book then watching its movie adaptation (like Charlotte's Web or Curious George), reading about places visited during travel (zoos, museums, natural areas), and doing family read-alouds where everyone takes turns reading and discussing the book over meals or campfires. Contact your student's Reading Corner teacher with questions.

item.title: March 2026 Breakfast and Lunch Menus
item.description:
Marshall Elementary has released its breakfast and lunch menus for March 2026.

Breakfast highlights include chocolate donuts, breakfast pizza, egg & cheese sandwiches, mini pancakes, glazed donuts, biscuits & gravy, French toast varieties, and themed items for St. Patrick's Day and spring. All breakfasts include 100% fruit juice, apples, oranges or other fresh fruit, and choice of milk.

Lunch highlights feature cheeseburgers, walking tacos, BBQ chicken, pizza options, chicken nuggets, spaghetti, hot dogs, chicken patties, mozzarella sticks, and special St. Patrick's Day and spring-themed meals. Choice of milk is included with every lunch.

Spring break begins March 30-31, 2026.
